items.title: Installer script throws checksum mismatch when trying to use the wheelnext download URL on Linux
items.reason: Closest observable symptom: checksum verification fails for a uv download. That report uses the official shell installer with INSTALLER_DOWNLOAD_URL pointing to WheelNext on Linux; comments describe replacing the installer's embedded checksum. It does not report disagreement between checksum assets for an official GitHub release, so it is adjacent rather than a duplicate.

items.title: Verify checksum in installer script
items.reason: Tracks installer checksum verification, rather than incorrect published checksum values. Maintainer comments identify cargo-dist as the installer generator and state that shell installers embed archive checksums since 0.11.0, while PowerShell verification was still missing. Useful subsystem context, but it does not track the reported 0.13.7 sidecar discrepancy.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using the exact archive name, sha256.sum, 0.13.7 with checksum, and broader checksum, sha256, checksum mismatch, incorrect hash, release digest, and sidecar terms. Separately searched possible causes and fixes using Windows signing, release signing, and internal:releases vocabulary. Inspected candidate bodies and comments, followed astral-sh/uv#13074 to axodotdev/cargo-dist#439 and astral-sh/uv#10336 to the closed, unmerged signing proposal astral-sh/uv#18280. No matching checksum-fix PR was found. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#14839 (Text file busy during self-update), astral-sh/uv#19282 and astral-sh/uv#21302 (missing mirror assets), and astral-sh/uv#18261 (release immutability). Independently compared the published ZIP, both checksum files, GitHub asset digests, and the checkout's archive-validation code.

type_reason: The currently published 0.13.7 ZIP hashes to the value recorded in both its individual .sha256 file and sha256.sum, and GitHub's asset digest agrees. The checkout also validates archive bytes against sidecar checksums before publication. No incorrect checksum, source-confirmed correctness defect, or matching existing discussion was established. Clarification requires the value and verification output the reporter received; these checks do not establish what they received earlier.
summary: astral-sh/uv#18736 covers a WheelNext installer checksum mismatch, and astral-sh/uv#13074 covers installer verification support. Neither tracks this alleged release-sidecar discrepancy; the current 0.13.7 ZIP and both checksum files agree.
draft_response: I checked the published 0.13.7 Windows ZIP: its SHA-256 is `0cdc5b38fe5a8168ed6a25814f5ba43c21d313dd3187314fccb37b7cec46e021`, matching both `uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256` and the entry in `sha256.sum`. GitHub's recorded asset digest agrees too. Could you share the checksum value you received, the exact verification command or tool, and its full output? That would help explain the discrepancy you're seeing.
